# Operating calendar

Northstar Market's Lagos fulfilment hub operates Monday through Saturday except for published closure dates. A closure changes warehouse dispatch timing; it does not change a customer's refund eligibility or the payment provider's settlement timing. Customer support should describe dates precisely and avoid inferring a delivery guarantee from a reopening date.

## Year-end closure

The Lagos fulfilment hub will be closed on 2026-12-24, 2026-12-25, and 2026-12-26. Normal warehouse dispatch resumes on 2026-12-27. Orders completed after the 2 PM cutoff before the closure will be handled according to the next available open dispatch day. Carrier collection schedules may differ from the warehouse calendar.

## Inventory count

The hub performs a weekly stock count every Monday before 10 AM. During this count, new same-day dispatch commitments should not be made until the stock check is complete. The count is an operational control, not a public shop closure. Customers can still place orders while the count is happening.

## Planned maintenance

On 2027-03-18, the Lagos hub will pause dispatch from 1 PM to 4 PM for conveyor maintenance. Orders already handed to a carrier are unaffected. This maintenance note does not apply to supplier allocation dates and does not change standard delivery estimates after dispatch.

## Calendar interpretation

The calendar records confirmed hub operating events, not customer demand or sales performance. A date that does not appear in this document should not be assumed to be a closure. Likewise, an open hub does not prove that every product was in stock or that a carrier collected every parcel. When a customer asks about timing, support should first identify whether the question concerns dispatch, carrier delivery, a payment review, or a refund. Those processes have separate evidence sources and their dates should not be combined into one promise.

## Customer communication

For an order affected by a listed closure, support may explain that dispatch follows the next open business day. It should not promise an exact delivery date because carrier schedules and address eligibility are outside this calendar. For maintenance pauses, support should describe the limited dispatch interruption but should not treat the hub as closed for the whole day. Dates in this document apply to the Lagos fulfilment hub only. They do not define supplier allocations, retail promotions, reward-point expiry, or the operating schedule of a third-party carrier.

The operations team reviews published closures before each seasonal period. A support agent should use the currently approved calendar rather than relying on a prior year's holiday pattern.
